The left-side figure also draws the crease PE, point E, point F, and A', but these folding-related elements do not affect finding the length of the rectangle diagonal AC. Then reason: It is known that in rectangle ABCD, AB=8 and BC=12. Adjacent sides of a rectangle are perpendicular to each other, so triangle ABC is a right triangle, with legs AB and BC.
